strategy: Build WYX as an apparel-led golf lifestyle store. Prioritize a complete but tightly edited wardrobe first: polos, tees, layers, shorts, pants, belts, headwear and gloves. Add premium bag, trip and custom accessories only when they reinforce the same visual identity. Reject generic feed filler even when it is technically sale-ready.

rules.preferredLandedMarginNote: Validate wholesale cost, shipping, fees, MAP, territory restrictions and expected gross margin before approval. Do not infer margin from retail pricing.

merchants.why: Best fit for the refined side of the new WYX apparel direction: restrained golf styling, strong wardrobe architecture and a current Green Grass program that explicitly welcomes clubs and shops interested in carrying the brand.
merchants.nextAction: Request retailer terms only after approval; first evaluate one core polo, one layer and one bottom as a three-piece premium test capsule.

merchants.why: Provides the wardrobe depth WYX currently lacks. Straight Down has an established wholesale business and a broad current golf-apparel catalog, making it a practical source for filling polos, layers and bottoms without going back to commodity feeds.
merchants.nextAction: Verify current small-retailer opening terms and line-sheet access; evaluate one understated polo, one waffle/quarter-zip layer and one pant or short before any commitment.

merchants.why: Useful as a controlled personality lane rather than the foundation of WYX. The brand actively supports retailers and says it is sold in more than 600 green-grass locations and boutiques.
merchants.nextAction: Treat as a one-or-two-style seasonal accent only; avoid turning WYX into a wall of novelty-print polos.

merchants.why: Strong route to distinctive accessories and future WYX-branded products instead of commodity inventory.
merchants.nextAction: Request wholesale/custom terms only after approval; prioritize a future WYX headcover, towel or marker capsule.

merchants.why: High-craft golf products with real material character; ideal for premium editorial photography and the elevated accessory layer around WYX apparel.
merchants.nextAction: Request wholesale account and samples only after approval; prioritize one forged accessory and one sewn travel/bag item.

merchants.why: A direct fit for WYX: modern visual identity, an established wholesale program, customizable products, and gloves/accessories that can finish the apparel story instead of competing with it.
merchants.nextAction: Request wholesale login and terms only after approval; price one premium glove family and one visual glove drop.

merchants.why: Handcrafted leather, waxed canvas and heritage materials add craftsmanship and texture around the clothing. Strong candidate for premium halo merchandise and golf-trip editorial storytelling.
merchants.nextAction: Request a small-account quote only after approval; prioritize one scorecard holder, one valuables pouch and one travel piece.

merchants.why: Strong fit for WYX trip positioning and a practical way to add a higher-ticket hero product after the apparel foundation is stronger.
merchants.nextAction: Price a six-unit test order only after approval and compare shipping, margin, colors and customization options.

merchants.why: Already represented in WYX. Expand only with distinctive products that support the apparel-led brand instead of rebuilding an accessories-heavy catalog.
merchants.nextAction: Review current wholesale assortment for one magnetic cleaning product and one visual hero piece only after the apparel gaps are filled.

merchants.why: Supporting merchandise only. Western Birch gives WYX a future private-label path without relying on generic tee inventory.
merchants.nextAction: Do not add another generic tee SKU. Price a small WYX custom run only when the apparel identity is established.

merchants.why: Useful route for modern headwear and selective apparel without requiring a large generic clothing catalog.
merchants.nextAction: Verify wholesale terms and evaluate one hat plus one apparel test product after approval.

merchants.why: Potential halo merchandise once apparel carries the brand identity.
merchants.nextAction: Verify reseller/corporate terms before considering any listing.

merchants.why: Strong style benchmark, but standard wholesale availability is not the preferred route. Treat as a future collaboration conversation rather than assumed inventory.
merchants.nextAction: No action until WYX has stronger sales volume or a collaboration concept.

targetAssortmentGaps: one premium solid or micro-pattern polo
one lightweight quarter zip or textured layer
one premium rope or unstructured hat
premium glove family with stronger visual identity
WYX-exclusive towel, marker or tee pack
